decision_rules.text: An authority agent issued BLOCK backed by at least one verified verbatim citation.
An authority agent needs information, an agent failed, or a verdict was unsupported by evidence.
At least one authority agent approved with conditions (all conditions are merged).
No authority agent responded in this stage; previous status is kept.
A suspension stays in force until the authority that issued it reviews the case again.
